data.narrative:
Kraken Robotics is a public-stage company operating in the Defense & Security sector. The comparable universe includes 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, with top private comparables including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. This represents a total of 10 identified peers across the sector.

The peer-median approach is not applicable to this valuation. A filtered peer set using same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar valuation-tier criteria yielded fewer than three datapoints, falling below the minimum threshold required for reliable median-based analysis. While 23 same-sector peers exist in Defense & Security broadly, none satisfied the narrow filters necessary to establish a defensible comparable cohort. An all-sector median approach would introduce excessive noise and is therefore inappropriate.

Given the inapplicability of peer-median triangulation, alternative valuation approaches—including precedent transaction analysis, DCF-based methods, or revenue/EBITDA multiples drawn from the identified public and private peer set—would be required to establish a credible valuation range. The scarcity of narrow-stage comparables represents a material constraint on precision. Any valuation synthesis would depend on which secondary methods can be reliably applied to Kraken's specific financial profile and should be accompanied by explicit disclosure of this methodological limitation.
